records.text: Owens relayed a tip that a gray Dodge Challenger might have been rented through Turo near Salt Lake City or Las Vegas around September 9 or 10.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: But this person reached out to us and also reminded us that it could have been somebody rented a car via the app Turo in those areas. So if Salt Lake City, Utah, I would also say Las Vegas, if you have a car and it got rented during those days and it happens to be a gray Dodge Challenger, check that as well.
